name: screening-copilot-proxy
description: Serves your GitHub Copilot chat models to the candidate screening console through a token-protected, localhost-only OpenAI-style endpoint.

screeningProxy.port.markdownDescription: TCP port of the proxy. The screening console finds a changed port automatically through the connection file in your home folder.

screeningProxy.host.markdownDescription: Address the proxy listens on. Keep `127.0.0.1` (this computer only). **Warning:** any other value (for example `0.0.0.0` or a network address) exposes the proxy, and with it your GitHub Copilot access, to other machines on the network; only the bearer token would protect it.

screeningProxy.autoStart.description: Start the proxy automatically when VS Code starts.

screeningProxy.modelFamily.markdownDescription: Copilot model id or family used when a request does not name an available model, for example `gpt-4.1`. Empty = the first model GitHub Copilot offers. `Screening Proxy: Show Status` lists the available models.

screeningProxy.maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of Copilot requests running at the same time. Further requests wait in a small queue; when the queue is full the proxy answers 429 (retry later).

screeningProxy.requestTimeoutSec.description: Seconds a request may take (including time waiting in the queue) before the proxy cancels it and answers 504.
